classification.difficultyReason: Three parallel lines add one decision: identify which pair of lines t belongs to before placing the co-interior arc. Still no calculation.

content.prompt: Draw an arc showing the angle co-interior to $t$.

answer.short: Arc at the top line, below it and right of the transversal.
answer.worked: $t$ is inside the middle and top lines. The marked angle is inside the same two parallels and on the same side of the transversal as $t$ (co-interior angles).

answer.short: Arc at the left-hand line, below the transversal and right of the line.
answer.worked: $t$ is inside the left and middle lines. The marked angle is inside the same two parallels and on the same side of the transversal as $t$ (co-interior angles).

answer.short: Arc at the bottom line, above it and right of the transversal.
answer.worked: $t$ is inside the bottom and middle lines. The marked angle is inside the same two parallels and on the same side of the transversal as $t$ (co-interior angles).

answer.short: Arc at the top line, below it, between the line's left arm and the transversal's down-right arm.
answer.worked: $t$ is inside the top and middle lines. The marked angle is inside the same two parallels and on the same side of the transversal as $t$ (co-interior angles).
